plugins.name: zcode-websearch
plugins.description: Web search for ZCode through the Tavily API: a two-step tool pair where web_search returns source links with short snippets and web_fetch reads exactly one URL in full, plus guidance on when to search and how to cite results.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 Tavily API 为 ZCode 提供联网搜索能力：web_search 只返回来源链接与短摘要，web_fetch 每次读一个 URL 的正文；所有长度上限由部署配置而非模型参数决定，以控制上下文开销。

plugins.name: newapi-admin
plugins.description: Full-surface administrator tooling for a New API (new-api) instance: channels, model metadata, model pricing and ratios, users, tokens, redemption codes, logs, statistics, groups, vendors and root system options. Ships a zero-dependency CLI plus an MCP server that reaches every management route, with an authoritative field-level reference distilled from the New API router and source.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 对 New API（new-api）实例做完整管理员运维：渠道、模型元数据、模型定价与倍率、用户、令牌、兑换码、日志、统计、分组、供应商与 Root 系统选项。附带零依赖 CLI 与 MCP 服务，覆盖全部管理路由，并沉淀了一份从 New API 路由与源码提炼的字段级参考文档。
